content: No! Never use drain cleaner or any non-food chemicals in cooking or baking. This would be extremely dangerous and toxic. If you want blue-colored waffles, use food-safe blue food coloring available in grocery stores, or natural options like blueberry puree. Drain cleaner is poisonous and could cause severe injury or death if ingested.
